blocks.text:
Free day.

The coast of Pernambuco is famous for its natural pools. At low tide, water remains between the reefs, forming small, warm lagoons where you can swim, watch fish and look at corals.

Beaches with stronger waves are suitable for surfing. Waves can reach around 2 metres. Windsurfing and water-skiing are also popular.

A few kilometres offshore lies Santo Aleixo Island, well known to divers.

Maracaípe beach is popular with surfers and hosts competitions. Muro Alto, by contrast, is sheltered by reefs, which enclose a large natural pool full of colourful fish.

Porto de Galinhas has many restaurants and cafés serving fish and seafood. In the evening, bars open, traditional shows take place and nightclubs welcome visitors.

You can spend the whole day by the sea or put together your own programme of beaches and water activities.

Porto de Galinhas makes a good end to the journey because, after the busy sightseeing days, there is time without a schedule: choose a beach to suit the weather, return to a favourite natural pool or spend a few hours at a waterfront café.
